required_invariants: branch context is copied and digest-bound at snapshot creation; shared mutable context is prohibited
snapshot is bound to exact checkpoint, WorkUnit, Attempt and dependency set
irrelevant dependency delta records continue and cannot cancel a branch
semantic assessments classify relevant deltas as material, immaterial or ambiguous; ambiguous impact enters explicit review rather than silently rebasing
affected context blocks are calculated from ContextRequirement dependency coverage
approved material rebase compiles replacement refs and context blocks into a new immutable snapshot; this slice does not execute agents
